title: Naturally Peppery Egyptian Snapper Fish Tagine
description: A diabetic-friendly Egyptian dish featuring tender snapper fish, this recipe is perfect for a healthy dinner option, utilizing a bain-marie and agave-leaf vessel for unique flavor and presentation.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the black pepper, coriander, cumin, and paprika.
Rub the spice mixture evenly over both sides of the snapper fish fillets.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and saute for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the snapper fish fillets to the skillet and sear for 2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
While the fish is baking, prepare the agave-leaf vessels by rinsing them with water and patting them dry.
To serve, place a snapper fish fillet in each agave-leaf vessel and drizzle with lemon juice.
